name: GoldenPark Casino
verdict: The GoldenPark.pt brand is operated in Portugal by Azartia Games, S.A., whose Portuguese operation belongs to Spain's family-owned MGA-New Park group (Sanahuja brothers). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: the chain is GoldenPark.pt -> Azartia Games, S.A. (SRIJ licences 029/030) -> Grupo MGA / MGA-New Park -> Joan and Enric Sanahuja Amat. All private owners in Spain and Portugal; no state or state fund was found in the chain in the sources checked, and no human-rights finding against the group, so nothing passes the METHOD.md test.
